name: Being Brave
overview: Scripture calls believers to be strong and courageous, trusting fully in the presence and faithfulness of the LORD. Deuteronomy 31:6 and Joshua 1:6,9 emphasize that God Himself goes before His people, assuring them not to fear or be dismayed because He will never fail or forsake them. The Psalms reinforce this confidence, encouraging hope in the LORD to strengthen the heart (Psalm 31:24) and promising protection for those who dwell in His presence (Psalm 91:1). This bravery is rooted in a steadfast reliance on God’s guidance and provision, as reflected in the shepherd imagery of Psalm 23:1.
